say:1:1224201001:1.source_cn: 很高兴你们能帮血薇这个忙。

say:0:1224202001:0.text: It's quicker to take the northern route. Follow me.
say:0:1224202001:0.source_cn: 去伐木场走北边比较快，跟我来。

say:2:1224202003:0.text: That's right. I was with you that time too.
say:2:1224202003:0.source_cn: 没错。那次也是我陪你们去的。

say:0:1224203001:0.text: Bella, what—*burp*! What brings you here?
say:0:1224203001:0.source_cn: 贝拉小姐，您——嗝！您怎么来了？

say:1:1224203002:0.text: Spare me the small talk. Now, this is your new supervisor.
say:1:1224203002:0.source_cn: 少啰嗦。给你介绍一位监工。

say:4:1224204002:1.text: You... You're that Water Wight who ran away! I got reamed out by my boss because of you!
say:4:1224204002:1.source_cn: 你……你是之前那个逃跑的水鬼！还害得我挨了一顿臭骂！
say:4:1224204002:1.male: You... You're that Water Wight who ran away! I got reamed out by my boss because of you!
say:4:1224204002:1.female: You... You're that Water Wight who ran away! I got reamed out by my boss because of you!

say:5:1224204003:1.text: Shut that! <style="stress"><player_name></style> is our honored guest, not a Water Wight!
say:5:1224204003:1.male: Shut that! <style="stress"><player_name></style> is our honored guest, not a Water Wight!
say:5:1224204003:1.female: Shut that! <style="stress"><player_name></style> is our honored guest, not a Water Wight!

say:6:1224204004:1.text: Also, why is the wood delivery to the port taking so long?! Is life here too cozy that you miss your dockworker days?
say:6:1224204004:1.source_cn: 倒是你。港口需要的木材为什么还没运过去！舒服日子过太久...

say:7:1224204005:1.text: That's not at all the case!

say:8:1224204006:1.text: The wood's ready, and we're bundling it up. It'll be loaded and shipped out soon!
say:8:1224204006:1.source_cn: 码头那边要的木材已经准备好了，劳工们正把它们捆起来呢，...

say:9:1224204007:1.text: Actually, we could have done it much faster if some of us hadn't been reassigned to the docks.
say:9:1224204007:1.source_cn: 不瞒您说，要不是码头那边临时调走了一批人，我们也不至于...

say:11:1224204009:1.text: Tell everyone to pick up the pace! We need to get the wood to the port.
say:11:1224204009:1.source_cn: 让他们动作都快一点，我们等着把木材运回港口。

narration:13:1224204011:0.text:
The lumberyard workers are firing on all cylinders to bundle up the wood.
However, it soon starts to drizzle.
narration:13:1224204011:0.source_cn: 伐木场里的劳工热火朝天地捆着木材\n但没过多久，天空突...

say:15:1224204012:0.text: Rats... I bet the rain will get heavier soon.
say:15:1224204012:0.source_cn: 坏事了……这雨待会肯定会变大。

say:18:1224204013:1.text:
The wood will get wet, won't it?
That's bad news...
say:18:1224204013:1.source_cn: 那会淋湿这些木材吧？\n这可真是个坏消息……

say:19:1224204014:1.text: Yes—*burp*! If the wood gets soaked, it could take ages to dry out completely! Wet wood can't be used, so it'll lead to more delays.
say:19:1224204014:1.source_cn: 是——嗝！是啊！木头要是淋了大雨，晒上好几天也未必能干...

say:22:1224204015:1.text: Argh! We can't afford more delays!

say:23:1224204016:1.text: Mork, I want you to load the rest of the wood before the rains get heavier! Otherwise, be prepared to face Lucca for your negligence!
say:23:1224204016:1.source_cn: 默克，在雨势变大之前，必须把剩下的木材全部捆好装车！否...

say:25:1224204018:1.text: Time's running out! Magister and your two hamsters, you're coming with me to <style="highlight">bundle up the wood</style>!

say:25:1224204018:1.female: Time's running out! Magister and your two hamsters, you're coming with me to <style="highlight">bundle up the wood</style>!

choice:3:1:2.text: You still burp a lot, huh?
choice:3:1:2.male: You still burp a lot, huh?
choice:3:1:2.female: You still burp a lot, huh?

say:0:1224205001:0.text: The rain's indeed getting heavier. Luckily, all the wood's been loaded.
say:0:1224205001:0.source_cn: 雨的确比刚才大了不少。万幸木头都捆好装车了。

say:1:1224205002:0.text: Let's get all the wood to the <style="highlight">docks</style> before it turns into a downpour!

say:0:1224207001:0.text: What on earth is going on?! Knock it off right now!

say:0:1224211001:0.text: How come Bella gets so worked up at the mention of sailing? Could there be a reason behind her reaction.
say:0:1224211001:0.source_cn: 贝拉为什么提到出海就那么生气呢？有隐情？

say:5:1224212005:1.text: Why were you so upset? Was it because of the two dockworkers? What they said didn't sound too offensive to me though...
say:5:1224212005:1.source_cn: 为什么这么生气呀？难道是因为那两个码头工人说的话？可是...

say:6:1224212006:1.text: ...I joined the Carmine Whispers because of the port blockade.
say:6:1224212006:1.source_cn: ……我就是因为港口被封锁才加入血薇帮的。

say:9:1224212007:1.text: Huh? I'm surprised some people find that policy appealing.

say:13:1224212010:0.female: Sailing... itself is dangerous, especially with the Dead Tide Fleet rampant at sea back then.

say:16:1224212013:1.female: Well, I've got to update <style="highlight">Lucca</style> about the situation at the docks. You should come along.

say:18:1224212009:1.text: ...I should have joined the Water Wights if that was the case!
say:18:1224212009:1.male: ...I should have joined the Water Wights if that was the case!
say:18:1224212009:1.female: ...I should have joined the Water Wights if that was the case!

choice:2:1:2.text: Your hair was standing on end.

choice:2:1:2.male: Your hair was standing on end.
choice:2:1:2.female: Your hair was standing on end.

say:20:1224212004:1.text: I'll take it as a compliment.
say:20:1224212004:1.male: I'll take it as a compliment.
say:20:1224212004:1.female: I'll take it as a compliment.

say:2:1224213001:1.text: Has all the wood been delivered to the docks?

say:3:1224213002:1.text: It's all done, Lucca. The foremen have started the repair work with the workers.
say:3:1224213002:1.source_cn: 都办妥了，二当家。派去的工头已经带人开工了。

say:8:1224213005:0.text: Since the repair's bound to take a while, you should get some rest in the meantime. I'll need your help once the docks are back in order.
say:8:1224213005:0.source_cn: 回去休息吧，修好码头也要一段时间。到时候，还有重要的事...
say:8:1224213005:0.male: Since the repair's bound to take a while, you should get some rest in the meantime. I'll need your help once the docks are back in order.
say:8:1224213005:0.female: Since the repair's bound to take a while, you should get some rest in the meantime. I'll need your help once the docks are back in order.

say:9:1224213006:1.text: Find me if you're up for some cash.
say:9:1224213006:1.source_cn: 如果想挣钱，可以来找我。
say:9:1224213006:1.male: Find me if you're up for some cash.
say:9:1224213006:1.female: Find me if you're up for some cash.

say:10:1224213007:1.female: There are plenty of things to be done, just like the rewards waiting for you.

choice:7:1:2.text: I'll be happy if you pay well!
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 只要报酬到位，什么都好说！
choice:7:1:2.male: I'll be happy if you pay well!
choice:7:1:2.female: I'll be happy if you pay well!

say:3:1224209001:0.text: Stop, everyone! I'm not here to deal with this mess!
say:3:1224209001:0.source_cn: 都住手！我不是来替你们收拾烂摊子的！

say:4:1224209002:0.text: All dockworkers, listen up—we Carmine Whispers aren't taking over the docks! Sonja's just trying to restore Rustport to its former glory!
say:4:1224209002:0.source_cn: 码头上的工人都听好了：血薇帮不会独占码头，我们当家的是...

say:5:1224209003:0.text: We've only sent a few foremen here so the construction won't affect your livelihood!
say:5:1224209003:0.source_cn: 我们只派了几个工头，是有考虑到你们还要靠码头吃饭的！

say:6:1224209004:0.text: You should appreciate our efforts instead of trying to hinder the construction! Do you want the port to be closed off forever?!
say:6:1224209004:0.source_cn: 你们不领情，还在这里阻碍施工！怎么，不想港口开放，就想...

say:7:1224209005:0.text: You're so full of hot air!

say:8:1224209006:0.text: Rustport ended up this way because of you lot! You were the ones who ordered the lockdown, and now you're also the ones pushing for its rebuild!
say:8:1224209006:0.source_cn: 锈锚港现在这德行，不都归功于你们血薇帮吗！当初下令封锁...

say:9:1224209007:0.text: Exactly! You have the final say, and we're always left to suffer because of your actions!
say:9:1224209007:0.source_cn: 就是这个理！你们永远有理，我们一帮只知道卖力气的大老粗...

say:10:1224209008:0.text: If it weren't for you, my family and friends could have joined a fleet and made a fortune!
say:10:1224209008:0.source_cn: 要不是你们，我的家人兄弟就能跟着船队出海，说不定还能做...

say:11:1224209009:0.text:
I can't reason with you...
Do you really think being a maritime trader is as simple as collecting shellfish in the sea?!
say:11:1224209009:0.source_cn: 你这个野蛮人……\n真当出海贸易和下海捞贝壳一样简单？！

say:12:1224209010:0.text: So many of us couldn't make it back from the sea... and then there was the threat of the Dead Tide Fleet! Remember what happened to those who fell into their hands?!
say:12:1224209010:0.source_cn: 多少船只没有返航，多少人没命回到锈锚港……更别提之前还...

say:13:1224209011:0.text: We don't care if you want to dig your own grave! But we can't let them take control of Rustport!
say:13:1224209011:0.source_cn: 你愿意去送命，血薇帮不管！但整个锈锚港，不能交由他们处置！

say:15:1224209013:0.text: Y—You've got a point, but something still feels off...
say:15:1224209013:0.source_cn: 虽……虽然你说的话有道理，但话也不能这么说吧……

choice_prompt:16:1224209013.text: Y—You've got a point, but something still feels off...
choice_prompt:16:1224209013.source_cn: 虽……虽然你说的话有道理，但话也不能这么说吧……

say:17:1224209014:0.text: Despite all the nice things you say, you guys have taken over the docks anyway!
say:17:1224209014:0.source_cn: 哼，大道理都让你们说了，码头也让你们占了！

say:18:1224209015:0.text: That's enough. I don't have time to bicker with you.
say:18:1224209015:0.source_cn: 够了，我没空和你们争辩。

say:22:1224209016:0.text: The wood's here. Waylan, get your men to start the repair work immediately. Don't waste your time in meaningless arguments again!
say:22:1224209016:0.source_cn: 木材都运到了。韦兰，你赶快带人去修码头。别再让我抓到你...

say:23:1224209017:0.text: If these dockworkers refuse to cooperate, just let them be. I'll send more people your way.
say:23:1224209017:0.source_cn: 至于这些码头工人——不乐意配合，那就让他们歇着。我再给...

say:24:1224209018:0.source_cn: 是，我这就让弟兄们开始干！

say:28:1224209019:0.text: Wait a minute... No one will hire us in the future if you do all the work here!
say:28:1224209019:0.source_cn: 这……码头上的活儿要是都被你们干了，以后谁还来找我们啊！

cinematic_dialogue:33:1224210002:.text: You have no chance to slack off; I'm watching you.
cinematic_dialogue:33:1224210002:.source_cn: 别想偷懒，我盯着你们呢

cinematic_dialogue:33:1224210003:.text: Let me help you with the wood!

cinematic_dialogue:33:1224210004:.source_cn: 约坎斯这个没出息的家伙……！

narration:35:12051216:0.text: After the dockworkers' protest is quelled, the repair work begins in an orderly fashion.
narration:35:12051216:0.source_cn: 码头工人的抗议暂时平息，工人们开始有序地工作。

choice:16:0:1.source_cn: 听你一席话，如听一席话

choice:16:1:2.source_cn: 血薇帮也是为了锈锚港

cinematic_dialogue:1:1224206001:.text: We want justice! We won't back down!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1224206002:.text: How dare you make a scene here! You must be tired of living!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1224206003:.text: Enough! It's plain as day you want to take over the dock!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1224206003:.source_cn: 别放屁！你们就是想独占码头！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1224206004:.text: Get back to the upper district! We want the dock back!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1224206004:.source_cn: 滚回上城区！把码头还给我们！

cinematic_dialogue:1:1224206005:.text: You want a fight, huh? Everyone, charge!
